# event

Handlers run when something happens: a new block, a closed bar, a fill. Register them at the top level.

| Name | Description |
| --- | --- |
| [`event.onStart()`](#event-onstart) | Runs once, before the first bar. |
| [`event.onStop()`](#event-onstop) | Runs once, after the last bar of the run. |
| [`event.onBlock()`](#event-onblock) | Runs on every block in precise, 1B and live runs. |
| [`event.onTrade()`](#event-ontrade) | Runs for every pool trade by anyone on the chain, after the block's `onBlock`, when trade data is loaded. |
| [`event.onBarUpdate()`](#event-onbarupdate) | Runs on every update of the open bar. |
| [`event.onCandle()`](#event-oncandle) | Runs once per bar when it closes (or, with `actOn: "final"`, when it is finalized). |
| [`event.onFill()`](#event-onfill) | Runs when one of the script's intents fills, fully or partly. |
| [`event.onReject()`](#event-onreject) | Runs when an intent is rejected: by a risk rule when it is created, or by its price limit, the cash or the pool when it would fill. |
| [`event.onExpire()`](#event-onexpire) | Runs when an intent waited longer than its `ttlBlocks` without a fill. |
| [`event.onPositionOpened()`](#event-onpositionopened) | Runs when a buy opens a position from flat. |
| [`event.onPositionClosed()`](#event-onpositionclosed) | Runs when a sell takes the position back to flat, with the round trip's realized profit in TAO. |
| [`event.onReorg()`](#event-onreorg) | Runs when the chain replaced blocks the script had already seen; the runtime has rewound its state to `toBlock`. |

### event.onStart() {#event-onstart}

```ts
event.onStart(fn: () => void): void
```

Runs once, before the first bar.

### event.onStop() {#event-onstop}

```ts
event.onStop(fn: () => void): void
```

Runs once, after the last bar of the run.

### event.onBlock() {#event-onblock}

```ts
event.onBlock(fn: (block: Block) => void): void
```

Runs on every block in precise, 1B and live runs. Quick backtests process whole bars and never call it.

Types: [Block](#block)

### event.onTrade() {#event-ontrade}

```ts
event.onTrade(fn: (trade: PoolTrade) => void): void
```

Runs for every pool trade by anyone on the chain, after the block's `onBlock`, when trade data is loaded.

Types: [PoolTrade](#pooltrade)

### event.onBarUpdate() {#event-onbarupdate}

```ts
event.onBarUpdate(fn: (bar: Bar) => void): void
```

Runs on every update of the open bar. Only called when the strategy sets `calcOnEveryBlock: true`.

Types: [Bar](#bar)

### event.onCandle() {#event-oncandle}

```ts
event.onCandle(fn: (bar: Bar) => void): void
```

Runs once per bar when it closes (or, with `actOn: "final"`, when it is finalized). The usual place to trade.

Types: [Bar](#bar)

### event.onFill() {#event-onfill}

```ts
event.onFill(fn: (fill: Fill) => void): void
```

Runs when one of the script's intents fills, fully or partly.

Types: [Fill](./account#fill)

### event.onReject() {#event-onreject}

```ts
event.onReject(fn: (rejection: Rejection) => void): void
```

Runs when an intent is rejected: by a risk rule when it is created, or by its price limit, the cash or the pool when it would fill.

Types: [Rejection](./trade#rejection)

### event.onExpire() {#event-onexpire}

```ts
event.onExpire(fn: (intent: Intent) => void): void
```

Runs when an intent waited longer than its `ttlBlocks` without a fill.

Types: [Intent](./account#intent)

### event.onPositionOpened() {#event-onpositionopened}

```ts
event.onPositionOpened(fn: (position: Position) => void): void
```

Runs when a buy opens a position from flat.

Types: [Position](./account#position)

### event.onPositionClosed() {#event-onpositionclosed}

```ts
event.onPositionClosed(fn: (closed: { position: Position; realizedTao: number }) => void): void
```

Runs when a sell takes the position back to flat, with the round trip's realized profit in TAO.

Types: [Position](./account#position)

### event.onReorg() {#event-onreorg}

```ts
event.onReorg(fn: (reorg: { fromBlock: BlockNumber; toBlock: BlockNumber }) => void): void
```

Runs when the chain replaced blocks the script had already seen; the runtime has rewound its state to `toBlock`.

Types: [BlockNumber](./types#blocknumber)

## Types

### Bar {#bar}

One bar (candle), as passed to `event.onCandle` and `event.onBarUpdate`.

| Field | Type | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `time` | [`Ms`](./types#ms) | bar open time |
| `open` | [`Price`](./types#price) |  |
| `high` | [`Price`](./types#price) |  |
| `low` | [`Price`](./types#price) |  |
| `close` | [`Price`](./types#price) |  |
| `volume` | `number` | alpha traded through the pool in this bar |
| `turnover` | `number` | TAO traded through the pool in this bar |
| `trades` | `number` | number of pool trades in this bar |
| `firstBlock` | [`BlockNumber`](./types#blocknumber) | first and last block in this bar |
| `lastBlock` | [`BlockNumber`](./types#blocknumber) |  |
| `confirmed` | `boolean` | `confirmed`: the bar has closed. `final`: its last block is finalized and can no longer be reorganized. |
| `final` | `boolean` |  |

### Block {#block}

One block of the subnet's pool, as passed to `event.onBlock`.

| Field | Type | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `number` | [`BlockNumber`](./types#blocknumber) |  |
| `time` | [`Ms`](./types#ms) |  |
| `price` | [`Price`](./types#price) | pool price after the block, TAO per alpha |
| `taoIn` | `number` | pool reserves after the block: TAO in the pool, alpha in the pool, alpha outstanding (staked) |
| `alphaIn` | `number` |  |
| `alphaOut` | `number` |  |
| `movingPrice` | [`Price`](./types#price) | the protocol's moving (smoothed) price |
| `trades` | `number` | pool trades in this block (bookkeeping rows excluded) |
| `volume` | `number` | alpha / TAO traded through the pool in this block |
| `turnover` | `number` |  |
| `final` | `boolean` | the block is finalized and can no longer be reorganized |

### PoolTrade {#pooltrade}

One trade through the pool by anyone on the chain, as passed to `event.onTrade`.

| Field | Type | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `id` | `string` |  |
| `time` | [`Ms`](./types#ms) |  |
| `block` | [`BlockNumber`](./types#blocknumber) |  |
| `side` | `"Buy" \| "Sell"` | Buy: TAO in, alpha out. Sell: alpha in, TAO out. |
| `price` | [`Price`](./types#price) |  |
| `alpha` | `number` |  |
| `tao` | `number` |  |
| `fee` | `number` | fee paid, in TAO |
